body:
Im 17 years old. I can't exactly call myself someone who knows everything about psychoactive substances. Although I am an experienced user with marijuana, magical mushrooms, mild forms of amphetamine (ritalyn) and acid, I have never really buried myself in random chemical drugs. So in all my wild lack of knowledge I desided to give it a shot.
I have been using 40mg Ritalyn pills (four times a day) for about two days prior to my first SSRI experience. Naturally I had almost no sleep, very little to eat and was quite stressed out. These are the uncomfortable sideffects I get from snorting ritalyn. Mind you I do not have A.D.D. One of my girlfriends uses SSRI on daily basis. She is a huge ditz and is basically fucked up all around but thats besides the point. I got out of my last class for the day and went to hook up with her. Shortly after we were done I saw that she gave some pills to one of my friends. I got very excited because I instantly knew what they were and I needed something to help me overcome the withdrawal effects of huge amounts of ritalyn. I took three of the pills and made my way back to the dorm.
Now I have never had any experiences with SSRIs. At all. I made an incorrect guesstimation that since others have snorted this shit before, I could too. One of the friends made a suggestion that I ingest it orally and not snort it. I crushed up one of the pills and it made quite a large pile of powder. The shell of the tablet appeared to be uncrushable and I had to fish it out of the little hill. My left nostril was about to explode from the previously snorted ritalyn so I used my right. I desided that I was going to snort this one real fast so that it surely gets absorbed. About three quarters through the line (half a second after the start) I realized that this is probably the most painful thing ever, my mouth is being drowned in saliva and my eyes are about to pop out of their sockets.
I did not finish the whole tablet and fell off of my chair because I completely lost any sense of coordination. I think I blacked out for about five minutes because a couple people appeared out of no where and put me on my bed.
I snorted this thing about twenty five hours ago. Its about 15:00 right now. The one thign I'm really not sure of is how I survived. I keep having constant black outs every five minutes or so, the back of my head feels like its been smashed wide open with a hammer, my eyes are dry and itchy, and I threw up a couple of times. This is probably the most horrible chemical experience I have ever had. Some of my friends told me that this will go on for a couple mroe days and then stop and I will be back to normal. There are virtually no pleasant aspects of this experience. Its just straight out horrible. I can think, can't concentrate, can't sleep, can't stay awake, can't read because the lines shake, can't focus on an object without the image shaking.
Overall I was always extremely paranoid, had huge mood siwngs, memory loss, blacked out and almost broke my head on the wall. There is no spiritual side to this experience. I just want it to end.
